newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber generally stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber generally stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices were generally stable in late trading on Tuesday amid weak buying interest, traders said.
They said a deal was done at 46.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang for June/July shipment.
"Prices in other places remain the same since this morning and I think traders will sell at those levels. The problem is buyers are scant," said one trader.
Traders said offer prices were unchanged at 47.25 fob Medan, 46.50 fob Padang, 46.75 fob Surabaya and 46.25 fob Jambi and Pontianak. They said supply was generally sufficient in the local market.
